games.drawSchedule: Monday, Wednesday and Saturday at approximately 11:30 PM Eastern Time, right after the main Powerball drawing.

games.name: Super Lotto
games.jackpotDescription: The Caribbean Lottery's shared Super Lotto jackpot game, offered in USVI.
games.payoutNote: Real schedule confirmed from thecaribbeanlottery.com/game-schedules (real schedule table: Super Lotto only populated on Tuesday/Friday at 9:00 p.m.). Pick shape confirmed from the game's own "How to Play" text: "the first set from 1 to 35 and the second set from 1 to 10 ... in St. Maarten and USVI each play costs US$2."

games.name: Lucky Pick
games.jackpotDescription: The Caribbean Lottery's Lucky Pick jackpot game, offered in USVI. Starting jackpot US$40,000.
games.payoutNote: Real schedule confirmed from thecaribbeanlottery.com/game-schedules (Lucky Pick populated daily at 8:00 p.m.). Pick shape + price confirmed from the game's own "How to Play" text: "Each panel contains numbers 1 to 28 ... Select five (5) numbers" and "Lucky Pick tickets cost US $2.00 (EC$5.00) per play with a starting Jackpot of US$40,000". A per-ticket Multiplier exists but isn't modelable from public draw data. Each draw also produces a separately drawn "Lucky Pick Double Play" set, built as its own game (vi-lucky-pick-double-play).

games.name: Lucky Pick Double Play
games.jackpotDescription: Lucky Pick's companion Double Play drawing.
games.payoutNote: Same session as Lucky Pick - a second, separately drawn 5-number set (same pattern as Powerball Double Play / Puerto Rico's Revancha), confirmed from the game's own text: "Double Play add-on is a second drawing that occurs right after [Lucky Pick]... allows a player to win up to a fixed top prize of US$10,000. Double Play cost US$1.00".

games.name: Pay Day
games.jackpotDescription: The Caribbean Lottery's Pay Day jackpot game, offered in USVI.
games.payoutNote: Real schedule confirmed from the game's own "How to Play" text: "Drawings are held daily at 7:30p.m." Pick shape confirmed from the same text: "the first set from 1 to 35 and the second set from 1 to 6 ... games.name: Pick 3 Morning
games.jackpotDescription: The Caribbean Lottery's Pick 3 digit game, offered in USVI.
games.payoutNote: Real schedule + mechanic confirmed from thecaribbeanlottery.com/games/pick-3's own "How to Play" text: 4 sessions daily (Morning 10AM/Midday 1PM/Sunset 6PM/Evening 9PM), and each session genuinely draws THREE independent digit sets ("1st"/"2nd"/"3rd" spot) checked against one ticket, confirmed via the site's own check-history results and its real prize table (which pays a different, descending amount per spot). "Mega Ball" add-on IS modeled (a real binary per-draw outcome, confirmed hitting 14/32 sessions in a wider real sample, not rare/inactive as an earlier narrower sample wrongly concluded) - a flat $1000 bonus on top of an already-won base prize, gated by the player purchasing it. Pair bets (Front/Back/Split Pair) not modeled, consistent with every other Pick3-style game in this app.

games.name: Caribbean Numbers Quiniela 1 PM
games.jackpotDescription: The Caribbean Lottery's Caribbean Numbers! game, Quiniela modality, offered in USVI.
games.payoutNote: Confirmed from thecaribbeanlottery.com/games/caribbean-numbers's own "How to Play"/"How to Win" text: 3 sessions daily (1 PM, 3 PM, 9 PM AST). One session draws 3 independent 2-digit (00-99) numbers (1st/2nd/3rd spot). Quiniela (pick 1): wins the prize for EVERY spot matched, ADDITIVELY - the site's own worked example: drawing 5,5,5 on a pick of 5 pays $60+$8+$4=$72. Base price not explicitly stated on this page (no $ wager column shown, unlike Pick 3/4's table) - used $1 as the standard digit-game default, flagged rather than silently assumed confirmed.
